quota_rule: 3 per level x A1/A2/B1/B2 — the STORIES_PER_LEVEL precedent (D-073). ⛔ No count is declared in 39 § 9 or in the brief; this is the precedent, ⛔ not a spec quote.
selection_rule: Every content word in subject_en, body_en and required_words_en was written against the bank dumped from allowedLemmasAtOrBelow(level, bank), where bank is built exactly as scripts/build-stories-sql.mjs builds it: parseBatchFile over data/generated/batch-*.jsonl, levels from buildLevelMap([cefrj-1.5, octanove-c1c2-1.0]) via assignWordLevels, lowest profileBand per lemma. ⛔ Not from allowed-words (surface forms) and ⛔ not from memory — lesson 19 (C-0248). Bank size on this run: 577 lemmas · A1 295 · A2 399 · B1 482 · B2 577.
pre_gate_check: Token-level set difference over the WHOLE draft file (subject + body + the required words) against the level's allowed set, using storyLemma — lessons 13 · 14. Result: 0 out-of-bank tokens, so 0 items needed a rewrite.
gate_run: messageGate(record, {allowedLemmas, allowedSenders}) on all 12 items — 12/12 passed in one round.
negative_control: Lesson 21: a first-round 100% is exactly when 'the gate worked' and 'the gate is not wired' look identical. 7 deliberately broken items, one per declared MessageGateReason, were run in the SAME harness run: sender_not_allowed · name_in_body · unknown_words · wrong_required_count · required_not_in_bank · required_not_in_body · digit_in_text. Result: 0/7 passed. The 12/12 is therefore measured, ⛔ not assumed.
sender_distribution: Tom 2 · Sarah 2 · Mr. Levi 2 · Dana 2 · Ben 2 · Ms. Cohen 2 — the closed list of docs/content-messages-brief.md, ⛔ unextended.
no_gate_axis: ⚠️ SENSITIVE SUBJECT HAS NO DETERMINISTIC GATE AND I DO NOT CLAIM ONE. I read all 12 items myself; every context is school or ordinary workplace correspondence (a class, a shop, schoolwork, a change at work, a group plan, a report, a plan problem, group work, a job offer, work outcome, a hard work decision, a new plan). That is ONE human eye. The Critic's reading is the second.
world_claims: T-193ⓓ: ⛔ no real place, ⛔ no price, ⛔ no date, ⛔ no clock time. Digits are gate-enforced (digit_in_text); relative time only ('this week', 'next month'), which is context, ⛔ not a claim about the world.
